# Processors & advanced logic leads supply risk; prices rising fast

**Bottom line:** Market supply risk is elevated at 67; price trend reads rising fast at 86 (medium confidence).

## What changed
- Semiconductor PPI +27.1% annualized over 6 months to Aug 2026 [1]
- Global chip sales $146.8B in Jul 2026, +134.9% YoY (SIA/WSTS) [2]
- 14 stories in 30 days, net tightening (+0.85). e.g. “Labor risks deepen semiconductor shortage strain amid AI investments - sourceability.com” | “Weekly news roundup: China gains ground in memory and AI hardware as supply stays tight” | “Meta Muse fuels agentic AI demand, tightening CPU supply” [3]
- TSMC 3-month revenue +54.5% YoY through Aug 2026 vs a typical +30.5% [4]
- Google News (supply): Labor risks deepen semiconductor shortage strain amid AI investments - sourceability.com [3]
- DigiTimes: Weekly news roundup: China gains ground in memory and AI hardware as supply stays tight [6]

## Segment board
- **Processors & advanced logic**: supply elevated (65); price rising fast (96); medium confidence
- **Memory (DRAM / NAND / HBM)**: supply rising (59); price rising fast (86); medium confidence
- **Microcontrollers & embedded**: supply rising (56); price rising fast (96); low confidence
- **Analog & power management**: supply neutral (53); price rising fast (96); low confidence
- **Power discretes (MOSFET / IGBT / SiC / GaN)**: supply neutral (52); price rising fast (96); low confidence

## Your BOM watchlist
- **10M08SAE144C8G** (logic): supply risk 65. Semiconductor PPI +27.1% annualized over 6 months to Aug 2026
- **XC7A35T-1CSG324C** (logic): supply risk 65. Semiconductor PPI +27.1% annualized over 6 months to Aug 2026
- **MT25QL128ABA1EW9-0SIT** (memory): supply risk 59. Semiconductor PPI +27.1% annualized over 6 months to Aug 2026
- **MT40A1G16TB-062E:F** (memory): supply risk 59. Semiconductor PPI +27.1% annualized over 6 months to Aug 2026
- **W25Q128JVSIQ** (memory): supply risk 59. Semiconductor PPI +27.1% annualized over 6 months to Aug 2026

## Negotiation angle
- Supply is tightening: prioritize allocation commitments and lead-time guarantees over unit price.
- Prices are firming: consider pulling forward buys on high-usage parts before increases land.
